context: A boss and his manager read morning sports headlines
purpose: Teach: 連盟/指名/辞任/遭遇/克服/寿命/メジャー/アイルランド

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: おはよう。今朝のスポーツ欄、もう目を通したかね?
lines.en: Morning. Have you already looked through the sports section?
lines.style: Authoritative boss opening, gruff but familiar morning greeting.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、ざっと。サッカー連盟の会長が突然辞任したそうですね。
lines.en: Yes, briefly. Apparently the soccer federation chairman suddenly resigned.
lines.style: Polite subordinate reporting, measured and informative office tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ほう、辞任か。後任には誰か有力な候補が指名されているのか?
lines.en: Oh, resignation? Has any strong candidate been nominated as successor?
lines.style: Curious senior probing for details with brisk authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 副会長が指名される見込みらしいですよ。ところでメジャーリーグの結果、ご覧になりました?
lines.en: The vice-chairman is reportedly being nominated. By the way, did you see the Major League results?
lines.style: Smoothly shifting topics, eager to share more news politely.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ああ、大谷だろう。怪我を克服して、また打ったらしいな。
lines.en: Ah, Ohtani, right? He overcame his injury and hit again, I hear.
lines.style: Warm admiration mixed with gravelly veteran fan commentary.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: そうなんです。選手寿命を考えると、本当に驚異的ですよ。
lines.en: That's right. Considering an athlete's career span, it's truly phenomenal.
lines.style: Genuinely impressed, animated but still respectful workplace register.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ラグビーの欄もあったろう。日本代表、アイルランドと再び遭遇するそうじゃないか。
lines.en: There was a rugby section too, wasn't there? Japan faces Ireland again, apparently.
lines.style: Engaged senior recalling another headline with slight excitement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、秋のテストマッチですね。前回の借りを返してほしいです。
lines.en: Yes, the autumn test match. I hope they pay back last time's defeat.
lines.style: Hopeful sports fan, warming up over morning coffee chat.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: さて、新聞はこのへんで。仕事に戻ろうか。
lines.en: Well, enough of the paper. Shall we get back to work?
lines.style: Decisive boss wrapping up the chat with gentle command.
